start.message:
Hi 👋

I'm your clan war bot — I stay with the clan and keep track of the fights.

🔍 I auto-watch regular wars and CWL
📣 I post battle start, end, and 1-hour-left alerts in the group
📋 I show members, attacks, and defenses with the war commands
🔗 I link Clash accounts to Telegram for mentions and easier follow-up

Commands: /help
Language: /setting

help.user: 📖 Bot help /war — Regular war status /cwl — CWL status /clan — Clan info /link #TAG — Link a Clash account /unlink #TAG — Unlink an account /myaccounts — Your linked accounts /setting — Language settings /help — This help
